invariants.text: 租户边界覆盖数据库 RLS、运行时上下文、事件、缓存和外部连接器。
经营事件、审批和关键回执只增不改；纠正通过新事件表达，不静默覆盖证据。
所有外部或变更性动作及其子调用，统一经过权限、PII、围栏和审批链路。
涉钱、敏感数据、群发、公开发布、交易和破坏性变更必须按高风险处理并由人审批。
没有真实回执就不能标记完成；mock、模拟和体验模式在数据结构与界面上都要明确区分。
客户原始经营数据不得上行；蜂群只接受白名单化、最小化、匿名化且可审计的元数据或派生经验。
租户覆盖层只能收紧围栏，不能放宽平台不可变红线。

platform-ops、平台账户运营和平台秘密只属于 Andromeda。

令牌、密码、API key、私钥、客户凭证和私密客户数据不得进入源码、文档、上下文、提示词、日志或提交。
个性化与行业扩展不得形成公共机制的第二事实源。

Native PRD ignores host requirement archives, and host G4 receives no controlled photo bytes. No paid image/video submitted.

cards.fix_plan: Install a per-instance native PRD adapter using the existing compiled requirement getter. Carry original full selected profiles/portrait receipt evidence into native agent prompts, validate exact identity before deterministic archive field binding, unify strictest existing thresholds, add original sidecar subtitle contract, validate Markdown/G4 ownership and actual ScriptEngine intake/output. Host G4 attaches every original photo byte and requires matching complete review proof. No vendor or gate rubric/threshold edit. Native BaseAgent ordinary PARSE retry remains unchanged; the instance system source is rebuilt in full on every request. ScriptGenerator full source character text and internal metadata aliases are checked before model invocation.
cards.blast_radius: Native G3-to-G4-to-ScriptEngine/PortraitStudio contract and host G4 evidence attachments; scoped to original Studio run, legacy no-archive narratives preserved; no DB migration, paid render, new pipeline or hand-written creative source.
